messages.subject: Saudi Arabia Executive Leadership | Energy, ESG, Government Relations and Country Strategy
messages.body:
Dear GR8 Connect SA Executive Search Team,

I am approaching GR8 Connect SA because your Kingdom-focused executive search work across energy, government and giga-projects aligns closely with the leadership mandates I am pursuing in Saudi Arabia.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and sustainability, external and corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, executive advisory and country-facing coordination within a major gold-mining operation.

My current work includes senior engagement with ministries and regulators, renewable-energy transition, carbon-accounting governance, social performance, institutional partnerships and cross-functional operating matters with executive-level visibility. Across 12+ years, my experience spans multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations.

Saudi Arabia is my first GCC priority. I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Country Leadership, External or Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, ESG and Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Chief of Staff and Executive Operations mandates across mining, energy, natural resources, infrastructure, giga-projects and industrial development. I am internationally mobile and open to expatriate, residential and rotational assignments.

I would welcome consideration for current or upcoming Saudi mandates where international operating experience, institutional engagement and sustainability leadership are central to the brief. My Gulf-focused executive CV is attached.

Preferred reply/contact: ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
